Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Woodbury for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events across Woodbury and nearby Lake Elmo, 2 of them free. The season runs from November 27 (Santa's Wonderland at Cabela's) through December 24, with two tree lightings (December 3 and 4), Cookies and Crafts with Santa at Eagle Valley Golf Course (December 19), The Best Christmas Pageant Ever at Merrill Arts Center (December 4 to 13) and Light Up Lake Elmo (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Woodbury

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Woodbury, including 2 from nearby Lake Elmo (one of them the Gingerbread Houses card moved from the Minneapolis page)
  • 2 free events: the Woodbury Tree Lighting Celebration and the community tree lighting at Woodbury Lutheran Church
  • Meet Santa: Cookies and Crafts with Santa at Eagle Valley Golf Course ($15 per child), Santa's Wonderland at Cabela's (free photo) and Santa's arrival at Light Up Lake Elmo
  • Parades and tree lightings: two tree lightings on December 3 and 4, plus the Lake Elmo tree lighting on December 5
  • Trains: no train ride in Woodbury; the CPKC Holiday Train stops in Cottage Grove on December 13 and at Saint Paul Union Depot

celebrates: Woodbury celebrates Christmas with two tree lightings in two nights. The City of Woodbury lights the Woodbury Tree on the South Patio at Central Park on Thursday, December 3, and Woodbury Lutheran Church lights its tree on Afton Road the next evening with live music. Woodbury Parks and Recreation hosts Cookies and Crafts with Santa in the Eagle Valley Golf Course banquet room, Merrill Arts Center stages The Best Christmas Pageant Ever in the Merrill Studio Theater, and Cabela's at 8400 Hudson Road offers a free photo with Santa. Neighboring Lake Elmo adds Light Up Lake Elmo along Lake Elmo Avenue.
lastyear: The City of Woodbury calls the 2026 event its second annual Tree Lighting Celebration, which means the first one was held in December 2025 and the city is building a new tradition at Central Park. We did not find a city recap of the 2025 evening, so this page lists only what the hosts have posted for 2026. Merrill Arts Center sells tickets for its holiday play through its own theater page, and the Woodbury Parks and Recreation seasonal events page lists the 2026 Santa sessions.
facts: Merrill Arts Center's holiday play, The Best Christmas Pageant Ever, is based on Barbara Robinson's book about the Herdman siblings who take over the church Christmas pageant, and the theater says a multi-generational cast of children and adults performs it under director John H. Potter. Cabela's lists a free 4 by 6 photo with Santa and a free shareable video, and the Eagle Valley Golf Course Santa sessions last one hour and start at 9, 10 and 11 am, noon and 1 pm.
trains: Woodbury has no train ride of its own that we could verify. The CPKC Holiday Train stops at Depot Park in Hastings on December 12 from 8:45 to 9:15 pm, according to the City of Hastings, and in Cottage Grove on December 13 at 5:15 pm, according to Explore Minnesota, with free concerts at both. In Saint Paul, the Minnesota Transportation Museum runs a train ride on Saturdays from the 1907 Jackson Street Roundhouse, and the Twin City Model Railroad Museum runs Night Trains.

faq: Woodbury holds two tree lightings on December 3 and 4, a Santa cookie and craft morning at Eagle Valley Golf Course, a holiday play at Merrill Arts Center and a free Santa photo at Cabela's. Lake Elmo adds Light Up Lake Elmo on December 5.
Is the Woodbury tree lighting free?
Yes. The City of Woodbury lists the Tree Lighting Celebration at Central Park as free, and Woodbury Lutheran Church lists its community tree lighting as free too.
Where do kids meet Santa in Woodbury?
Santa joins Cookies and Crafts at Eagle Valley Golf Course on December 19, and Cabela's at 8400 Hudson Road lists a free photo with Santa.
Are there train rides near Woodbury?
Not in town. The CPKC Holiday Train stops in Hastings on December 12 and Cottage Grove on December 13, and Saint Paul has the Minnesota Transportation Museum.
